title: [review] rules.rs:380: MQTT_SN rule won't match link-
description: Comment says 'use global (Ignore) to support both link-local and global addresses in one rule' but FD_IPV6_SRC_GLOBAL and FD_IPV6_DST_GLOBAL use Mo::Msb matching which requires the top 64 bits to equal fd00:0000:0000:0000. Link-local addresses (fe80::/10) will fail this match because fe80 != fd00. Either the code should use Mo::Ignore for the address fields, or the comment is documenting incorrect behavior.
close_reason: Fixed: Added FD_IPV6_SRC_ANY and FD_IPV6_DST_ANY field descriptors using Mo::Ignore with Cda::ValueSent, and updated MQTT_SN_FIELDS to use them. This allows the MQTT_SN rule to match both link-local (fe80::/10) and global addresses.
